spec.rawSql:
select time, energy_produced as energy
from agg_1h_energy_priced
where $__timeFilter(time)
order by time;

spec.description: PV production in the range (data_solar_production): the measured PV input power since 2026-10-22, derived from the inverter and battery counters before. Battery discharge isn't counted as production, and battery losses don't reduce it.
spec.title: Production

spec.rawSql: select time, energy_used as energy from agg_1h_energy_priced where $__timeFilter(time) and metered order by time;

spec.description: Everything the household used in the range, the car included: grid import plus self-consumption. Hours without smart meter data are left out.
spec.title: Consumption

spec.rawSql:
select time, case when metered then energy_consumed end as energy
from agg_1h_energy_priced
where $__timeFilter(time)
order by time;

select time, case when metered then energy_feeded end as energy
from agg_1h_energy_priced
where $__timeFilter(time)
order by time;
select coalesce(sum(energy_self_consumption) / nullif(sum(energy_self_consumption + energy_feeded), 0), 0) as "Self-use share" from agg_1h_energy_priced where $__timeFilter(time) and metered;

spec.description: Share of the PV production that the household used itself rather than fed into the grid: self-consumption / (self-consumption + feed-in). Metered hours only.
spec.title: Self-use share

spec.rawSql: select coalesce(sum(energy_self_consumption) / nullif(sum(energy_used), 0), 0) as "Autarky" from agg_1h_energy_priced where $__timeFilter(time) and metered;

spec.description: Share of the household's consumption covered by its own PV: self-consumption / consumption. Metered hours only.
spec.title: Autarky

spec.rawSql: select time, price_consumed as cost from agg_1h_energy_priced where $__timeFilter(time) and metered order by time;

spec.description: Cost of the grid import in the range at the contract's hourly prices, standing charges not included.
spec.title: Grid cost

spec.rawSql: select time, price_feeded + price_self_consumption as value from agg_1h_energy_priced where $__timeFilter(time) and metered order by time;

spec.description: What the PV was worth in the range: feed-in revenue plus the grid cost avoided by self-consumption.
spec.title: PV value

spec.rawSql:
select time_bucket('1 ${bucket}', time, 'Europe/Vienna') as time,
       sum(energy_self_consumption) filter (where metered) as "Self-consumption",
       sum(energy_consumed) filter (where metered) as "Grid import"
from agg_1h_energy_priced
where $__timeFilter(time)
group by 1
having bool_or(metered)
order by 1;

spec.description: Consumption per ${bucket} (the bucket follows the time range), split into what the PV supplied directly (self-consumption) and what came from the grid. Buckets without smart meter data are left out.
spec.title: Consumption by source

spec.rawSql: select time, pv_kw as "PV" from data_power_live where $__timeFilter(time) order by time;

spec.description: PV power right now (data_power_live, 15 s rows).
spec.title: PV

spec.rawSql:
select time_bucket('1 ${bucket}', time, 'Europe/Vienna') as time,
       sum(energy_self_consumption) filter (where metered) as "Self-consumption",
       sum(energy_feeded) filter (where metered) as "Feed-in",
       sum(energy_produced) as "Production",
       sum(energy_self_consumption) filter (where metered)
         / nullif(sum(energy_self_consumption + energy_feeded) filter (where metered), 0) as "Self-use share"
from agg_1h_energy_priced
where $__timeFilter(time)
group by 1
order by 1;

spec.description: Self-consumption and feed-in per ${bucket} (the bucket follows the time range) against PV production (line), with the self-use share on the right axis. The bars count energy leaving the inverter when it is used, the line what the panels delivered, so the bars can sit below the line (battery losses, charging) or above it (discharging). Hours the smart meter has not delivered yet show production only.
spec.title: Where the PV energy goes

spec.rawSql:
select time_bucket('1 ${bucket}', time, 'Europe/Vienna') as time,
       sum(price_feeded) filter (where metered) as "Feed-in revenue",
       sum(price_self_consumption) filter (where metered) as "Avoided grid cost",
       sum(price_consumed) filter (where metered) as "Grid cost"
from agg_1h_energy_priced
where $__timeFilter(time)
group by 1
having bool_or(metered)
order by 1;

spec.description: What the PV earned per ${bucket} (the bucket follows the time range): feed-in revenue plus the grid cost avoided by self-consumption, against the grid cost (line).
spec.title: Value of the PV

spec.description: Average energy per clock hour of the day (Europe/Vienna) over the selected range: when the PV produces and when the household draws from the grid.
spec.title: Typical day

spec.rawSql:
select time_bucket('1 ${bucket}', time, 'Europe/Vienna') as time,
       avg(pv_kw) as "PV", avg(house_kw) as "House", avg(grid_kw) as "Grid",
       avg(battery_kw) as "Battery", avg(battery_soc) as "Battery SOC"
from data_power_live
where $__timeFilter(time)
group by 1
order by 1;

spec.description: Average power per ${bucket} (the bucket follows the time range) from the live monitor (data_power_live): PV, house, grid (positive = import) and battery (positive = charging), with the battery charge level on the right axis.
spec.title: Power profile

spec.rawSql:
select to_char(c.month, 'Mon YY') as "Month",
       case when c.energy_inverter > 0 then c.energy_used end as "Consumption",
       case when p.energy_inverter > 0 then p.energy_used end as "A year before"
from agg_1month_energy_priced c
left join agg_1month_energy_priced p on p.month = c.month - interval '1 year'
where c.time >= (date_trunc('month', now() at time zone 'Europe/Vienna') - interval '11 months') at time zone 'Europe/Vienna'
order by c.month;

spec.description: Household consumption (grid import plus self-consumption, car included) per month over the last 12 months, next to the same month a year earlier. The current month is the month to date.
spec.title: Consumption vs. a year before

spec.rawSql:
select to_char(c.month, 'Mon YY') as "Month",
       case when c.energy_inverter > 0 then c.energy_produced end as "Production",
       case when p.energy_inverter > 0 then p.energy_produced end as "A year before"
from agg_1month_energy_priced c
left join agg_1month_energy_priced p on p.month = c.month - interval '1 year'
where c.time >= (date_trunc('month', now() at time zone 'Europe/Vienna') - interval '11 months') at time zone 'Europe/Vienna'
order by c.month;

spec.description: PV production per month over the last 12 months, next to the same month a year earlier. The current month is the month to date.
spec.title: Production vs. a year before

spec.rawSql:
-- One row per month, stamped at local midnight on the 1st. Smart meter rows are stamped at the end of their quarter.
with mp as (
  select id, timezone from master_smartmeter_metering_point where feeding = false
), sm as (
  select e.time - interval '15 minutes' as quarter, e.energy * 4 as kw
  from data_smartmeter_energy e
  join mp on mp.id = e.metering_point_id
  where e.time > (date_trunc('month', now() at time zone 'Europe/Vienna') - interval '11 months') at time zone 'Europe/Vienna'
), live as (
  select time_bucket('15 minutes', time) as quarter, avg(greatest(grid_kw, 0)) as kw
  from data_power_live
  where time >= (select max(e.time) from data_smartmeter_energy e join mp on mp.id = e.metering_point_id)
    and time < time_bucket('15 minutes', now())
  group by 1
), q as (
  select * from sm
  union all
  select * from live
)
select date_trunc('month', quarter, (select timezone from mp)) as time,
  max(kw) as "Max grid import"
from q
group by 1
order by 1

spec.description: Highest grid import per month as a 15-minute average over the clock quarters, the value the grid operator's smart meter records (data_smartmeter_energy, consuming metering point: kWh per quarter × 4 = kW). Quarters the meter has not delivered yet (it arrives the next day) come from data_power_live as the average import of the quarter, finished quarters only. Months are local (Europe/Vienna).
spec.title: Max grid import (15 min)

spec.rawSql: select time, energy_self_consumption / nullif(energy_used, 0) as "Autarky" from agg_1month_energy_priced where energy_inverter > 0 and time >= (date_trunc('month', now() at time zone 'Europe/Vienna') - interval '11 months') at time zone 'Europe/Vienna' order by time;

spec.description: Share of each month's consumption covered by the household's own PV: self-consumption / consumption.
spec.title: Autarky

spec.rawSql:
with irr as (
  select time_bucket('1 hour', time - interval '1 second') as t, avg(gti) as gti
  from data_irradiance where $__timeFilter(time) group by 1),
measured as (
  select time_bucket('1 hour', time) as t from data_solar_energy
  where $__timeFilter(time) and time < (select min(time) from data_power_live)
  union
  select time_bucket('1 hour', time) from data_power_live where $__timeFilter(time)),
pv as (
  select p.time as t, p.energy_produced as pv_kw
  from agg_1h_energy_priced p
  join measured m on m.t = p.time
  where $__timeFilter(p.time)),
h as (
  select irr.t, irr.gti, pv.pv_kw from irr join pv using (t) where irr.gti > 20)
select gti as "Irradiance",
       case when extract(year from t at time zone 'Europe/Vienna') = extract(year from now() at time zone 'Europe/Vienna') then pv_kw end as "This year",
       case when extract(year from t at time zone 'Europe/Vienna') = extract(year from now() at time zone 'Europe/Vienna') - 1 then pv_kw end as "Last year",
       case when extract(year from t at time zone 'Europe/Vienna') < extract(year from now() at time zone 'Europe/Vienna') - 1 then pv_kw end as "Older",
       regr_intercept(pv_kw, gti) over () + regr_slope(pv_kw, gti) over () * gti as "Trend"
from h
order by gti;

spec.description: Hourly PV production (data_solar_production, kWh per hour = average kW) against the hourly mean irradiance on the tilted panel plane (data_irradiance, Open-Meteo, hours above 20 W/m²). The points follow a line whose slope is the plant's output per W/m²; points well below it mark shading, soiling or a fault, or a mismatch between the modelled and real sky. The red line is the least-squares fit over the shown hours. Points are coloured by year: this year, last year and older; the red trend line covers all of them. Hours between 2025-06 and 2026-04 scatter more: the FusionSolar cloud data of that time books part of the yield late.
spec.title: PV vs irradiance

spec.rawSql:
with irr as (
  select time_bucket('1 hour', time - interval '1 second') as t, avg(gti) as gti
  from data_irradiance where $__timeFilter(time) group by 1),
measured as (
  select time_bucket('1 hour', time) as t from data_solar_energy
  where $__timeFilter(time) and time < (select min(time) from data_power_live)
  union
  select time_bucket('1 hour', time) from data_power_live where $__timeFilter(time)),
pv as (
  select p.time as t, p.energy_produced as pv_kw
  from agg_1h_energy_priced p
  join measured m on m.t = p.time
  where $__timeFilter(p.time)),
h as (
  select irr.t, irr.gti, pv.pv_kw from irr join pv using (t) where irr.gti > 20)
select sum(pv_kw) / (sum(gti) / 1000) / 3.6 * 100 as "Performance ratio" from h;

spec.description: PV energy relative to what the 3.6 kWp plant would deliver at the irradiation on its panel plane, over the picked range: kWh produced / (kWh/m² of irradiation × 3.6 kWp), from the hours with both PV and irradiance data. A healthy plant typically reaches 70-85 %. The level depends on the modelled orientation (36° tilt, 60° west of south, both measured), shading and the modelled irradiance, so watch the trend rather than the level; a drop over time points to soiling, shading or a fault.
spec.title: Performance ratio

spec.rawSql: select time, house_kw as "House" from data_power_live where $__timeFilter(time) order by time;

spec.description: House consumption right now, the car charger included.
spec.title: House

spec.rawSql:
with irr as (
  select time_bucket('1 hour', time - interval '1 second') as t, avg(gti) as gti
  from data_irradiance where $__timeFilter(time) group by 1),
measured as (
  select time_bucket('1 hour', time) as t from data_solar_energy
  where $__timeFilter(time) and time < (select min(time) from data_power_live)
  union
  select time_bucket('1 hour', time) from data_power_live where $__timeFilter(time)),
pv as (
  select p.time as t, p.energy_produced as pv_kw
  from agg_1h_energy_priced p
  join measured m on m.t = p.time
  where $__timeFilter(p.time)),
h as (
  select irr.t, irr.gti, pv.pv_kw from irr join pv using (t) where irr.gti > 20)
select time, "Performance ratio",
       regr_intercept("Performance ratio", extract(epoch from time)) over ()
         + regr_slope("Performance ratio", extract(epoch from time)) over () * extract(epoch from time) as "Trend",
       regr_intercept(adjusted, extract(epoch from time)) over ()
         + regr_slope(adjusted, extract(epoch from time)) over () * extract(epoch from time) as "Seasonally adjusted trend"
from (select time, "Performance ratio",
             "Performance ratio" / avg("Performance ratio") over (partition by extract(month from time))
               * avg("Performance ratio") over () as adjusted
      from (select time_bucket('1 day', t, 'Europe/Vienna') as time,
                   sum(pv_kw) / (sum(gti) / 1000) / 3.6 * 100 as "Performance ratio"
            from h
            where t < time_bucket('1 day', now(), 'Europe/Vienna')
            group by 1
            having sum(gti) > 500) days) adjusted_days
order by time;

spec.description: Daily performance ratio of the 3.6 kWp plant: PV energy / (irradiation on the panel plane × 3.6 kWp). Red: least-squares trend over the shown days, which also contains the season (the range rarely covers whole years). Blue: the same trend after dividing each day by the average of its calendar month and rescaling to the overall mean, so only a change over the years remains; with two to three years of data it is indicative, not conclusive. Days with under 0.5 kWh/m² and the current, incomplete day are left out.
spec.title: Daily performance ratio

spec.rawSql:
with irr as (
  select time_bucket('1 hour', time - interval '1 second') as t, avg(gti) as gti
  from data_irradiance where time >= (date_trunc('year', now() at time zone 'Europe/Vienna') - interval '3 years') at time zone 'Europe/Vienna' group by 1),
measured as (
  select time_bucket('1 hour', time) as t from data_solar_energy
  where time >= (date_trunc('year', now() at time zone 'Europe/Vienna') - interval '3 years') at time zone 'Europe/Vienna' and time < (select min(time) from data_power_live)
  union
  select time_bucket('1 hour', time) from data_power_live where time >= (date_trunc('year', now() at time zone 'Europe/Vienna') - interval '3 years') at time zone 'Europe/Vienna'),
pv as (
  select p.time as t, p.energy_produced as pv_kw
  from agg_1h_energy_priced p
  join measured m on m.t = p.time
  where p.time >= (date_trunc('year', now() at time zone 'Europe/Vienna') - interval '3 years') at time zone 'Europe/Vienna'),
h as (
  select irr.t, irr.gti, pv.pv_kw from irr join pv using (t) where irr.gti > 20)
select to_char(make_date(2000, m, 1), 'Mon') as "Month",
       sum(pv_kw) filter (where y = this_year - 0) / nullif(sum(gti) filter (where y = this_year - 0) / 1000, 0) / 3.6 * 100 as "This year",
       sum(pv_kw) filter (where y = this_year - 1) / nullif(sum(gti) filter (where y = this_year - 1) / 1000, 0) / 3.6 * 100 as "Last year",
       sum(pv_kw) filter (where y = this_year - 2) / nullif(sum(gti) filter (where y = this_year - 2) / 1000, 0) / 3.6 * 100 as "2 years ago",
       sum(pv_kw) filter (where y = this_year - 3) / nullif(sum(gti) filter (where y = this_year - 3) / 1000, 0) / 3.6 * 100 as "3 years ago"
from (select extract(month from t at time zone 'Europe/Vienna')::int as m,
             extract(year from t at time zone 'Europe/Vienna')::int as y,
             extract(year from now() at time zone 'Europe/Vienna')::int as this_year,
             pv_kw, gti
      from h) x
group by m
order by m;

spec.description: Performance ratio per calendar month, one column per year (the current year and the three before it, independent of the time picker), so the same season is compared with itself; lower columns in later years point to real degradation or soiling. Months without data are empty, and the current month is incomplete.
spec.title: Monthly performance ratio by year

spec.rawSql: select time, grid_kw as "Grid" from data_power_live where $__timeFilter(time) order by time;

spec.description: Positive = importing from the grid, negative = feeding in.
spec.title: Grid

spec.rawSql: select time, battery_soc as "Battery" from data_power_live where $__timeFilter(time) order by time;

spec.description: Battery state of charge.
spec.title: Battery

spec.rawSql:
-- data_solar_production is the PV production counter (kWh): the inverter's
-- AC counter without battery charge/discharge since the Modbus switch, dips
-- dropped (TASK-085). Production since the start of the range = the counter
-- minus the last one before the range, or the first one in it.
select time,
       energy - coalesce(
         (select max(energy) from data_solar_production
          where time < $__timeFrom() and time >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '7 days'),
         first_value(energy) over (order by time)) as energy
from data_solar_production
where $__timeFilter(time)
order by time;

spec.description: PV production since midnight (data_solar_production): the measured PV input power of the live monitor, in 5-minute steps. Battery losses don't reduce it. The FusionSolar app can differ by around 5%; that is expected.
spec.title: Production today

spec.rawSql:
-- Consumption since midnight: 5-minute averages of house_kw (kW) / 12 = kWh,
-- summed up over the day.
with b as (
  select time_bucket('5 minutes', time) as time, avg(house_kw) / 12 as kwh
  from data_power_live
  where $__timeFilter(time)
  group by 1
)
select time, sum(kwh) over (order by time) as "Consumption"
from b
order by time;

spec.description: House consumption since midnight including the car, from data_power_live (5-minute averages).
spec.title: Consumption today

spec.rawSql:
-- Car since midnight: 5-minute averages of goe_kw (kW) / 12 = kWh,
-- summed up over the day.
with b as (
  select time_bucket('5 minutes', time) as time, avg(goe_kw) / 12 as kwh
  from data_power_live
  where $__timeFilter(time)
  group by 1
)
select time, sum(kwh) over (order by time) as "Car"
from b
order by time;

spec.description: Energy the wallbox delivered since midnight, from data_power_live (5-minute averages).
spec.title: Car today

spec.rawSql:
select time, house_kw as "House", grid_kw as "Grid", pv_kw as "PV",
       battery_kw as "Battery", goe_kw as "Car charger",
       battery_soc as "Battery SOC"
from data_power_live
where $__timeFilter(time)
order by time;

spec.description: House consumption and where it comes from, per 15 s. Grid positive = from the grid, battery positive = charging. Near-live from the collector's live power monitor (data_power_live): read every 5 s from the inverter's power meter, averaged per 15 s, written every 30 s, so up to about 45 s behind.
spec.title: House power

spec.definition:
select case
  when $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz <= interval '3 days' then 'hour'
  when $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz <= interval '93 days' then 'day'
  when $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz <= interval '2 years' then 'week'
  else 'month' end
spec.description: Bucket of the Period tab's time series: hour up to 3 days, day up to 93 days, week up to 2 years, month beyond
spec.label: Resolution
spec.name: bucket

spec.rawSql:
select case
  when $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz <= interval '3 days' then 'hour'
  when $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz <= interval '93 days' then 'day'
  when $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz <= interval '2 years' then 'week'
  else 'month' end
